## Corrected {#corrected}

The first version of this brief said that none of the site existed yet and that its address was still to be settled. That was wrong: [web-summit.sgit.ai](https://web-summit.sgit.ai/) had been live since 28 October 2026, two days before. The site section and the limits are corrected, the change is in the [version history](../web-summit-team-brief.md), and it is logged on the [corrections page](https://newsroom.sgit.ai/about/corrections.html).
